description: An upstream overloaded reply (529 with the overloaded_error type) to a non-streamed Chat request reaches the client as an error body built from the upstream's error type and message.

exceptions.reason: The new core answers a Chat client with OpenAI's error body, error.code holding Claude's error type and error.type server_error for a 5xx; today's core passes Claude's envelope (type error) through.

Today's core adds metadata.user_id, a hash it derives from the request, to every request it translates to Claude; the new core does not make up a user identifier for the client.
